text.description_html:
Laurey 39666, Paris Cabinet Knob in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Paris Oil Rubbed Bronze Knob is a stunning example of traditional hardware done right. It adds interest, old world beauty and manages to affordable enough you can redo all your cabinets. The Paris Cabinet Knob in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Paris Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39666 1-1/4" Knob Paris Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:

Oil Rubbed Bronze Matte Black

Sold Individually
